months: YYYY-MM. from null means the start of the record; through null means open-ended.
independently_verified: True only for a date confirmed by an external record (regulator or broadcaster) whose window contains the archive-dated boundary. The dates here were read from the archive's own pilot series.

20.evidence: A step-down rather than a departure: the 2022-09 step leaves a persistent live carrier (post-step months stay 97-100% masked), so the post-step floor is a measured ambient carrier level, conservative as a kept-frame bound but not a transmitter-off sensitivity floor.

32.evidence: Departure bounded inside the 2021-2022 collection gap: strong through 2020-11; first collected off month 2023-02. Any month inside a gap yields identical masks. Superseded value: 2022-10 in pilot-proxy tools/make_chain_table.py:41 (OFF_FROM); the release uses 2023-02 (decision D14).

35.evidence: Off before sign-on: the monthly excess record steps on at 2021-11 (2021-09 and 2021-10 sit at the off level), so the off epoch runs through 2021-10. One later month, 2022-09, sits back at the off level; a single month-threshold mask cannot represent it and counts it on.
